text.arabic_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

words.gloss_range: fronted definite judgment-day time frame that gathers the whole bodily-evidence sequence
words.root_gloss_range: day, appointed time, decisive occasion, and accountability setting; locally the definite fronted form selects the appointed judgment occasion
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-yawma}}) stands first, so the reader enters the scene through an appointed judgment time before any organ or actor is named. Its definite, singular, fronted time-frame gathers sealing, hand-speech, foot-witness, and the final earning clause into one forensic procedure rather than a string of detached marvels. Same-surah day references at 36:54, 36:55, 36:59, and 36:64 make this another stage of that judgment day, while the Day of Recompense frame (1:4) becomes concrete as bodily evidence. Even the movement from the clipped opening time-word to the extended final earning cadence supports the arc from decisive moment to accumulated conduct.

topics.headline: fronted appointed day frames the procedure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the bodily testimony as one appointed judgment procedure rather than a sequence of disconnected wonders.
topics.reason: The QAC row marks a fronted accusative temporal adverb, and the clause chain remains coordinated under that temporal opening.

topics.headline: judgment-day references (36:54; 36:55; 36:59; 36:64; 1:4)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah specializes the larger judgment-day refrain into a mechanism of evidence.
topics.reason: The concrete references support a same-surah progression and a recompense frame without changing the local adverbial grammar.

topics.headline: opening time and closing earning cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an audible arc from the short time opening to the long final conduct phrase.
topics.reason: The sound rows add secondary support to the same local movement from appointed time to accumulated earning.

words.gloss_range: active first-person plural sealing action imposed over mouths, with closure carrying evidentiary finality
words.root_gloss_range: sealing, closing, finishing, and authenticating; locally the verb selects imposed closure that also certifies the end of oral control
words.prose: {{ar:نَخْتِمُ}} ({{tr:nakhtimu}}) is the first finite action after the time frame, and it is active first-person plural: the forensic sequence begins with divine agency, not with a neutral closing. The verb governs an over-preposition rather than a direct mouth object, so the mouth is treated as a surface under imposed closure. The {{ar:خ ت م}} ({{tr:kh-t-m}}) range makes that closure feel final and certificatory: oral self-defense is blocked, and the sealed state itself becomes evidence. The passive variant pressure confirms that agency could have been backgrounded, while the base reading keeps it audible; comparison with perception sealing at 2:7 and final-seal language at 83:25-26 sharpens the move from blocked reception to blocked expression. Its rare procedural use and consonant movement into final lip closure make the sealing feel marked rather than routine muting.

topics.headline: active divine sealing agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine agency initiates the bodily-evidence sequence before any limb speaks.
topics.reason: The active imperfect carries first-person plural subject agreement, while variant rows show that deagentivization is contrastive rather than controlling.

topics.headline: sealing over a mouth surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mouths are covered as speech surfaces rather than treated as ordinary direct objects.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the mouth noun as governed by the intervening preposition, supporting imposed surface closure.

topics.headline: closure with certification pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the seal as finalizing and evidentiary, while local grammar keeps the selected act as mouth closure.
topics.reason: The broader seal and signet range contributes finality and authentication pressure, but the local frame selects the act of sealing mouths.

topics.headline: closure before replacement testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that testimony appears only after the normal speech channel is closed.
topics.reason: The clause order places the sealing verb before the coordinated hand-speech and foot-witness verbs.

topics.headline: sealing references (2:7; 83:25-26)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this sealing targets expression and defense, not perception as in 2:7.
topics.reason: The reference rows are concrete and coherent; they qualify the seal field without overriding the local mouth target.

topics.headline: marked seal sound and rarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sealing verb as a marked procedural choice rather than routine muting.
topics.reason: Distribution and sound rows add secondary payoff to the same marked judgment action.

words.gloss_range: preposition of imposed overness on the mouth target, with liability pressure secondary to spatial coverage
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) is the small word that makes the seal spatial and coercive. It places closure over the mouths, blocking an inside-the-mouth or merely concerning reading. Its range can carry liability pressure too, but the local sealing frame selects imposed superposition first; the long recitational surface then slows the movement from sealing act to mouth target.

topics.headline: imposed overlay on the mouth target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the seal as something imposed over the speech outlet and against its owners.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes the mouth noun the prepositional complement; lexical range permits liability pressure while local grammar selects overness.

topics.headline: prepositional delay before the organ
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a grammatical and audible layer between the act of sealing and the organ named next.
topics.reason: The intervening preposition is locally required and also creates the structural delay noted by the rows.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural mouths as concrete speech outlets made the covered target of sealing
words.root_gloss_range: mouth, oral opening, and speech outlet; locally the organ stands for the claim-channel that is closed
words.prose: {{ar:أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ}} ({{tr:afwāhihim}}) names possessed plural mouths as the first body part in the evidence map. Grammatically, the mouths are dependent targets under the preposition, not acting subjects; the suffix ties them to the same owners whose hands and legs will testify. The {{ar:ف و ه}} ({{tr:f-w-h}}) field keeps the organ concrete while carrying speech-outlet force, so the ayah closes the channel of claim-making without needing an abstract word for speech. Its narrow organ-root and vowel-heavy articulation make the oral aperture sharply present at the moment it is closed. References to mouth-claim exposure at 3:167 are answered here by procedure: the mouth that could mismatch inner reality is sealed, and the body sequence moves downward from claim-channel to action and movement.

topics.headline: possessed mouth target under the preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that these are the defendants' own mouths, grammatically made covered targets before other organs act.
topics.reason: The noun is plural, suffixed, and governed through the preposition, matching the target and ownership rows.

topics.headline: speech outlet closed as claim-channel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is sealed is the concrete outlet of self-presentation and defense.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports mouth as oral opening and speech outlet, while local grammar keeps the concrete organ as the selected target.

topics.headline: body map and mouth-claim reference (3:167)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first step in a descending body map from claim to action to movement.
topics.reason: The concrete 3:167 and body-sequence rows fit the local progression without changing the mouth's grammatical role.

topics.headline: concrete and audible mouth specificity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the mouth as a sharply specified organ, not a generic symbol for speech.
topics.reason: Rarity and sound observations reinforce the local concrete organ target.

words.gloss_range: first conjunction pivoting from mouth closure to replacement hand-speech without isolating the clauses
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from sealed mouths to speaking hands without allowing the second clause to float away as spectacle. It can coordinate and carry circumstantial force, so hand-speech is joined to the sealing state while not being reduced to a strict result particle. The fused onset on the following speech verb makes the turn from silence to replacement speech visible and audible inside the clause chain.

topics.headline: first pivot from closure to replacement speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hand-speech is grammatically joined to mouth-sealing as a replacement channel.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the hand-speech clause to the sealing clause and allows both coordination and circumstantial closeness.

topics.headline: fused audible reset before hand speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small audible hinge at the moment the evidence channel changes.
topics.reason: The form and sound rows add a local payoff to the same clause pivot.

words.gloss_range: Form II directed speech from hands to the divine speaker, with bodily marks made articulate
words.root_gloss_range: speech, address, word, and mark or wound pressure; locally directed address is selected while mark-pressure colors embodied evidence
words.prose: {{ar:تُكَلِّمُنَآ}} ({{tr:tukallimunā}}) makes the hands speak to the divine speaker directly: the object suffix is built into the verb, and Form II gives the speech a directed-address shape. The delayed subject means the speech act is heard before the organ is named, producing a forensic surprise between mouth closure and formal witness. The {{ar:ك ل م}} ({{tr:k-l-m}}) range lets speech remain articulate language while mark or wound pressure makes the hands' acted traces feel as if they have become speakable evidence. The geminated lām compresses the sound at the speech verb, matching the forced emergence of testimony from non-oral organs. The Form V and lām-variant pressures are useful apparatus, but the base reading keeps coordinated directed address; comparison with nonhuman speech at 27:82 intensifies the scene because the address here is to God.

topics.headline: directed speech to the divine speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hands do not merely speak; they address the divine speaker as recipient of testimony.
topics.reason: The verb carries an explicit first-person plural object suffix and Form II address force.

topics.headline: speech before the hand subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the impossible speech act before discovering that the speaker is the hands.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies the following hands as delayed subject and the suffix as object.

topics.headline: speech with embodied mark pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices acted traces becoming articulate evidence, while the selected local sense remains directed speech.
topics.reason: The root field can carry speech and mark pressure, but local Form II with an object suffix selects address, so the mark sense is secondary image-pressure.

topics.headline: variant result pressure without replacing base reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant pressures expose possible result or self-expression readings, while the base surface prioritizes direct address.
topics.reason: The variant rows are valid as contrast, but they do not govern the canonical local parse.

topics.headline: nonhuman speech reference (27:82)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an intensified courtroom role: nonhuman or non-ordinary speech is redirected toward God.
topics.reason: The concrete 27:82 comparison survives as contrast because the local object suffix makes the direction of speech distinct.

topics.headline: speech hinge and geminated pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hand-speech verb as the hinge between sealing and witness.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and sound rows reinforce the local hinge position without adding a separate lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural hands as delayed speaking subject and embodied agency of deeds
words.root_gloss_range: hand, reach, grasp, power, possession, and responsibility; locally the organ of doing becomes the speaker of agency
words.prose: {{ar:أَيْدِيهِمْ}} ({{tr:aydīhim}}) finally identifies the speaker: the possessed plural hands are the delayed subject of the speech verb. Their broken plural form is gathered under feminine singular agreement, so many agencies speak as one witness while remaining the defendants' own hands. The {{ar:ي د ي}} ({{tr:y-d-y}}) range keeps hand, power, responsibility, and deed close together; the ayah makes agency itself speak against its owner. The derivational dispute keeps morphology visible but does not displace the local hand sense. The repeated possessive ending and comparable limb cadence anticipate the legs, making the two bodily witnesses audible as a pair before their functions separate. References to hand-earned corruption at 30:41 and the hand-accountability formula at 78:40 show why the organ of doing can become the organ of testimony here.

topics.headline: owned delayed hand subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speaking source is revealed only after the speech act and remains owned by the defendants.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the hands as delayed subject, and agreement evidence supports the collective feminine singular verb.

topics.headline: hand agency becomes witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the organ of doing and responsibility now takes over the mouth's communicative role.
topics.reason: The local noun remains hands, while the root field supports agency, power, and deed as semantic pressure.

topics.headline: derivational dispute without changing hand sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the plural form's morphology at the point where hands become grammatical speakers, without replacing the local sense.
topics.reason: The dispute is valid morphological pressure, but local grammar and context keep the meaning as possessed hands.

topics.headline: hand-accountability references (30:41; 78:40)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hand-linked accountability elsewhere becomes direct hand-speech in this scene.
topics.reason: The concrete 30:41 and 78:40 references support the local agency role without changing the syntax.

topics.headline: hands paired with legs in body map
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hands and legs as paired but distinct bodily witnesses.
topics.reason: The repeated possessive body-part forms and ordered clause chain preserve the paired-limb payoff.

words.gloss_range: second conjunction adding a distinct formal witness clause after hand-speech
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the foot-witness clause as a fresh evidentiary step, not as a paraphrase of hand-speech. It preserves parallelism while escalating from directed speech to formal attestation. The repeated conjunction also creates the ayah's second small hinge, first from sealed mouths to hands and now from hands to legs.

topics.headline: second conjunction adds formal witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that foot testimony is added as a separate evidentiary act rather than merged into hand-speech.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates a new clause with its own verb and subject, preserving distinction and cumulative evidence.

topics.headline: second audible pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a second hinge that raises communication into legal attestation.
topics.reason: The fused conjunction and repeated onset support the structural escalation already licensed by syntax.

words.gloss_range: active witnessing over the open content of what was earned, performed by the legs in the scene
words.root_gloss_range: presence, observation, witness, and legal attestation; locally bodily presence becomes formal testimony
words.prose: {{ar:تَشْهَدُ}} ({{tr:tashhadu}}) turns the next limb clause into formal attestation. It is active and imperfect, and its content is opened by the following prepositional phrase, so the legs testify about the broad field of what was earned rather than one named deed. The {{ar:ش ه د}} ({{tr:sh-h-d}}) range joins presence and testimony: the body parts can attest because they were present in the movement of action. Its breath-to-stop consonant texture gives the witness verb a firm landing that suits formal attestation. Bodily testimony parallels at 24:24 and 41:20 are narrowed here into action and movement organs, and the sequence upgrades hand speech into legal witness.

topics.headline: active witness scoped to earned content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices legs actively testifying over the earned-content field, not merely containing traces.
topics.reason: The verb is active imperfect and the following prepositional phrase supplies the content of testimony.

topics.headline: presence becomes legal attestation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices bodily presence at actions becoming formal proof.
topics.reason: The root range supports presence, observation, and witness; local grammar selects legal attestation by the legs.

topics.headline: bodily testimony references (24:24; 41:20)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that broader bodily testimony scenes are specialized here into hands and legs after mouth sealing.
topics.reason: The concrete parallels fit the local courtroom mode and help define what is distinctive about the selected organs.

topics.headline: speech escalates into witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the chain moving from directed hand-speech to formal foot-witness.
topics.reason: The verb sequence and delayed body-part subjects bind the two limb clauses as a parallel testimony pair.

topics.headline: firm witness sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices secondary sound texture supporting the formal witness register.
topics.reason: The sound and register rows reinforce the local attestation without changing the lexical selection.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural legs as delayed witness subject and movement record
words.root_gloss_range: leg, foot, standing, support, and walking; locally movement and placement become evidence
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْجُلُهُم}} ({{tr:arjuluhum}}) reveals the witness source after the verb: possessed plural legs, gathered by feminine singular agreement into one testimony voice. The {{ar:ر ج ل}} ({{tr:r-j-l}}) range keeps standing, support, walking, and footed movement visible, so the testimony concerns where embodied agency went, stood, and participated. The leg clause pairs with the hand clause but does not duplicate it: hands carry action-agency, while legs carry movement and placement. Its rounded possessive cadence leans toward the final earning phrase, audibly connecting movement organs to the repeated conduct they attest. Parallels at 24:24 and the same-surah movement contrast at 36:20 help show how the root-field shifts from a public man arriving to bodily movement testifying.

topics.headline: owned delayed leg subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices testimony before its source, then learns the source is the defendants' own legs.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the legs as subject of the witness verb, with suffix ownership tying them to the same group.

topics.headline: movement and standing become evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices routes, standing, and bodily movement becoming part of the evidentiary record.
topics.reason: The root field supports leg, foot, support, and movement, while the local noun selects the possessed body part as witness.

topics.headline: action and movement body map
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hands and legs cover different evidentiary domains: doing and going.
topics.reason: The clause order and paired possessed limb forms make hands and legs mutually interpretive but not interchangeable.

topics.headline: feet witness references (24:24; 36:20)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the feet-witness field is localized into this judgment scene after mouth sealing.
topics.reason: The concrete 24:24 and 36:20 references support the local movement-witness payoff.

topics.headline: leg cadence leads toward final earning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sound of the leg noun leaning toward the final earning closure.
topics.reason: The cadence row gives secondary support to the connection between movement organs and repeated earning.

words.gloss_range: prepositional marker opening the testimony-content phrase, with content and causal liability both in play
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) opens the closing evidentiary scope phrase. Most directly, it gives the witness verb its content: about what they used to earn. Its range also keeps basis or liability pressure alive, so the testimony is both concerning the deeds and grounded because of them. Broader attachment to hand-speech or the whole scene is possible as secondary scope, but local syntax makes the witness-content relation primary; the repeated particle complex across the boundary from 36:64 shifts from punishment cause to evidence content.

topics.headline: witness content and basis marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not stop at the witnesses; it turns to the content and basis of testimony.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following content head governed by the preposition as the matter testified to.

topics.headline: scope can widen but witness relation is primary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final phrase can gather the whole limb sequence, while grammar keeps the foot-witness attachment strongest.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL scope range is coherent, but attachment evidence gives the witness verb the most direct local relation.

topics.headline: compact boundary particle complex (36:64)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a compact hinge that turns from witnesses to the charge-field and carries a boundary shift from 36:64.
topics.reason: The fused preposition-plus-content form and boundary repetition provide a real formal payoff without changing the syntactic scope.

words.gloss_range: open nonpersonal content head for the full habitual earning clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the open content head that lets the final clause hold the whole field of acquired deeds without naming a single offense. It stands before the habitual-past clause, so the charge-field is announced broadly and then filled by repeated earning. Relative and maṣdarī readings both remain useful: the phrase can point to what they earned and to the earning itself, keeping deed and process together. The same compact particle complex also repeats across the boundary from 36:64, but here it functions as testimony content rather than punishment cause.

topics.headline: open content head for earned deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the testimony covers an open deed-field rather than one named offense.
topics.reason: The particle heads the relative content clause and supplies the open object field for the earning verb.

topics.headline: relative and maṣdarī double reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both what was earned and the process of earning remain in the evidentiary phrase.
topics.reason: Both readings are compatible with the following auxiliary-plus-imperfect clause and preserve broad content.

topics.headline: compact broad charge-field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices compression: a long conduct history is gathered into one small content head before being unfolded.
topics.reason: The order places the open content head before the habitual-past clause, making breadth visible before duration.

topics.headline: boundary particle shift (36:64)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same compact particle form links denial and earning across the boundary while changing function.
topics.reason: The 36:64 boundary row is concrete and locally useful as a function shift, not as a replacement for the local parse.

words.gloss_range: auxiliary in a past-habitual frame, binding the possessors to repeated earning rather than bare existence
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, remaining, occurrence, and state; locally the form recedes into aspectual framing of persistent past conduct
words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) opens the final explanatory tail as an auxiliary, not as a standalone event of being. With the following imperfect, it makes earning a past-habitual pattern: the body does not expose one episode but a maintained course. The plural ending binds the clause back to the possessors of mouths, hands, and legs, while the boundary shift from second-person address in 36:64 to third-person report here places the condemned inside evidence. The {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) field can evoke being, state, and locatable occurrence, but locally it recedes into the aspectual frame. The exact phrase-shape in 83:14 and the 36:64 constructional echo keep habitual past conduct in the judgment register, and the repeated long ū sounds stretch the close around that ongoing past pattern.

topics.headline: auxiliary marks habitual past
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sustained course of earning rather than a single completed deed or bare existence.
topics.reason: The perfect auxiliary before an imperfect complement creates durative past aspect in the local clause.

topics.headline: being-state pressure under aspect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices past conduct as a state-history, while local grammar keeps the verb auxiliary rather than lexical existence.
topics.reason: The root range supports being and state, but the auxiliary construction selects aspectual framing.

topics.headline: same owners and person shift (36:64)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same group moved from direct address into third-person evidence tied to their own body parts.
topics.reason: The plural subject agreement and possessive-chain evidence bind the final clause to the same defendants, while 36:64 supplies the boundary contrast.

topics.headline: habitual formula references (36:64; 83:14)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final clause as part of a judgment pattern linking denial, earning, and evidence.
topics.reason: The concrete 36:64 and 83:14 rows support a formulaic habitual-past reading without changing the local syntax.

topics.headline: rounded habitual closure cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final auxiliary phrase stretching the close around repeated conduct.
topics.reason: The cadence and tail-position rows reinforce the explanatory role of the final clause.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural earning verb for repeated acquired liability under an open object field
words.root_gloss_range: earning, gaining, acquiring, pursuing, and incurring; locally acquisition becomes attributable liability evidenced by the body
words.prose: {{ar:يَكْسِبُونَ}} ({{tr:yaksibūn}}) is the ayah's final word, so the whole sequence resolves into repeated acquisition. Under the auxiliary, the imperfect makes conduct habitual rather than a closed one-time act, and the open object supplied before it lets the deed inventory remain comprehensive. The {{ar:ك س ب}} ({{tr:k-s-b}}) range keeps gain, acquisition, and incurring together; in this testimony context, what is acquired remains chargeable to the actors. Pursuit or capture pressure can sharpen the image of moral acquisition, but local grammar selects attributable earning, not an independent hunting scene. The plural ūn cadence closes on the same group whose organs have testified. References at 30:41, 2:286, 36:54, and 83:14 show the same accountability logic becoming embodied proof here, while 36:54's work-language is answered by earning evidence.

topics.headline: open object keeps deed inventory broad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verb does not narrow the charge to one named deed.
topics.reason: The verb's object field is supplied by the preceding open content head, preserving broad scope.

topics.headline: habitual final ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices repeated acquisition as the reason toward which sealed mouths and speaking limbs have been moving.
topics.reason: The imperfect complement under the auxiliary creates habitual past aspect, and final position gives the verb explanatory weight.

topics.headline: acquired liability, not neutral gain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices gain or acquisition as something attributable and chargeable to the actor.
topics.reason: The root range supports acquisition and incurring; the testimony context selects chargeable acquired outcome.

topics.headline: pursuit image without replacing earning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices moral acquisition as actively pursued and accumulated, while the local form remains broad Form I earning.
topics.reason: The pursuit and reflexive contrast rows sharpen the image but do not replace the local Form I earning construction.

topics.headline: plural owners in the final verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final verb closing on the same plural group whose organs have testified.
topics.reason: The plural ending and implicit subject connect the final verb to the possessive chain on body parts.

topics.headline: accountability references (2:286; 30:41; 36:54; 83:14)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earning-language elsewhere about accountability becomes embodied evidence in this ayah.
topics.reason: The concrete references support accountability and habitual-earning payoffs without changing the final verb's local syntax.

topics.headline: boundary turns denial into liability (36:64)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from prior denial and work-language into acquired liability exposed by the body.
topics.reason: The 36:64 and 36:54 boundary rows are concrete and preserve the transition into the final earning word.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نختم على أفواههم / تكلمنا أيديهم / تشهد أرجلهم / بما كانوا يكسبون
baseline_models.mechanism: The preventive seal disables the mouth's ordinary speech outlet. Intelligible address and informed declaration are reassigned to organs implicated in action and movement, making the body an adverse witness to accumulated acquisition.

activation_trace.role: A secured preventive closure removes the mouth as the person's controllable evidentiary outlet.
The mouth is literally the opening used for speech, so its closure marks a deliberate channel switch.
Intelligible speech connecting interlocutors gives the hands a direct address to Us, not merely a vague sign.
Attribution of action and offense to the hands makes their speech evidence from the operative organ itself.
Informed declaration and disclosure make the feet formal witnesses rather than decorative speakers.
Walking on the feet anchors their testimony in the person's pursued course and movements.
Deliberate acquisition supplies the accumulated object about which the organs testify.

changed_reading.before: A silenced person is miraculously contradicted by talking limbs.
changed_reading.after: A controlled evidentiary transfer disables self-defending speech and assigns action and movement organs independent testimony about acquired deeds.

baseline_models.mechanism: The seal can stamp and authenticate as well as bar access; a bodily wound can itself be a speaking mark, and a witness can be a sign. The closed body therefore also reads as an authenticated evidentiary surface bearing the effects of what its organs acquired.

activation_trace.role: Stamping and its impressed mark add authentication to the mouth's closure.
A bodily wound is an effect that can 'speak' by remaining visibly on the body.
A distinguishing sign can stand as witness, allowing bodily evidence to be legible without reducing it to ordinary voice.
The physical hand supplies one surface and instrument on which action can leave evidence.
The physical foot supplies the second bodily surface and instrument of the record.
The image of acquisitive limbs binds bodily organs directly to what was gained or done.

changed_reading.before: The seal only gags, while hands and feet must acquire new voices.
changed_reading.after: The seal also authenticates a body-record whose operative organs disclose deed-effects as voices, marks, or signs.

baseline_models.mechanism: The severe present 'day' closes a previously extended course of acquisition. The imperfect after كانوا presents earnings as recurrent historical activity, so the organ testimony is a terminal accounting of a lived pattern rather than an isolated act.

activation_trace.role: The day as a severe event supplies the decisive present in which the prior course is exposed.
Reaching an endpoint turns the seal into closure of the acquisition period as well as closure of speech.
Occurrence through past time gives the earning clause temporal duration.
Repeated acquisition accumulates the matter now brought to account.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a single extraordinary event on the judgment day.
changed_reading.after: The extraordinary event is the closure and bodily audit of a long, repeatedly acquired history.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier writing of what people advanced, their remaining traces, and exhaustive enumeration supplies a register mechanism. The foot-image inside ق د م and the lasting-sign image inside أثر make the later feet especially apt witnesses: action sent ahead leaves a traversed trace that the body can disclose.

activation_trace.role: The action-attributing hand becomes one embodied location from which the earlier register is read.
Witness as a sign permits the registered traces to function as testimony.
The walking organ physically connects a lived route to the traces it leaves.
Writing and the written object supply the explicit durable-record component.
The treading foot latent in what they 'advanced' bridges prior deeds to the feet that later testify.
A remaining mark that indicates what happened gives the record a trace-based evidentiary form.
Exhaustive counting makes the bodily disclosure comprehensive rather than anecdotal.

structural_cues: 36:12 coordinates what was written, what people advanced, their آثار, and total enumeration in a clear register.
36:65 coordinates hands, feet, and the relative clause بما كانوا يكسبون as sources and object of disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an external-looking register, advanced deeds, surviving traces, and exhaustive count; I infer that 36:65 re-materializes that record in the acting body. A live alternative is that the register and bodily testimony remain separate but corroborating evidence systems.

changed_reading.before: The limbs give new oral testimony alongside an already complete record.
changed_reading.after: The limbs are themselves a readable instantiation or corroborating layer of the earlier record of advanced deeds and surviving traces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from contention to exact recompense for intentional work and then separates the مجرمون. The جرم inventory itself joins earning to offense, so يكسبون becomes a chargeable acquisition whose matching consequence is established by bodily witnesses.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring something for oneself supplies the focus term that the juridical context reclassifies.
Evidence declared from knowledge gives the reclassified acquisitions a formal proof mechanism.
Contention between adversaries supplies the dispute setting in which independent evidence matters.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the exact settlement rule for the testimony.
Intentional work identifies conduct, rather than mere possession, as the matter repaid.
The earning and causing-to-earn branch directly bridges the مجرم label to يكسبون.
Offense and culpable act give that same acquisition a juridical valence.

structural_cues: 36:54 denies injustice and limits recompense to what people used to do.
36:59 separates the مجرمون before 36:64-65 states consequence and bodily testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recompense, intentional work, a disputed setting, and a root that spans earning and offense; I infer that bodily testimony converts accrued conduct into a settled claim. The alternative remains that مجرم merely labels the people and does not lexicalize every instance of كسب as crime.

changed_reading.before: What they earned is a broad label for past behavior.
changed_reading.after: What they earned is an accrued and contested liability whose correspondence to recompense is established by the body's own evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated human contention and controlled قول are displaced by the branch in which a thing's indication is its 'saying.' The known contrast between concealment and disclosure then makes the speaking hand and witnessing foot an evidentiary indication that escapes the person's rhetorical control.

activation_trace.role: The secured gag removes the adversary's controlled verbal channel.
The hands still communicate intelligibly, preserving genuine address after the channel switch.
A bodily sign can witness even if the organ's 'speech' is indicative rather than vocal.
A thing's indication counting as its saying supplies a non-rhetorical mode for bodily speech.
Adversarial dispute characterizes the human speaker whose mouth is denied final control of the case.
Concealment in the interior supplies what controlled outward speech might hide.
Manifest disclosure supplies the direction in which bodily indication moves the concealed material.

structural_cues: The surah repeatedly stages denial, argument, and contested قول; 36:77 names the human a manifest adversary.
36:76 pairs their قول with what they conceal and what they disclose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adversarial speech, concealed and manifest material, and a branch where a thing signifies by 'saying'; I infer that the focus replaces advocacy with self-indicating evidence. Literal vocalization of the limbs remains a fully live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The mouth is silenced only so other organs can deliver equivalent spoken sentences.
changed_reading.after: Controlled advocacy is displaced by the body's own indications, which disclose what rhetorical speech could conceal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following hypotheticals erase sight, prevent forward and backward movement, and invert bodily formation. This sharpens the focus's organ-role reversal: feet cease to be merely means of passage and become witnesses to the course they once enabled.

activation_trace.role: Walking is the feet's ordinary function that can be converted into evidence about a traversed course.
Presence and direct observation let the moving organ testify from participation.
Erasing a trace supplies the threatened opposite of the preserved bodily evidence.
Passage and going through name the forward mobility that can be withdrawn from the feet.
Return names the reverse mobility likewise denied, enclosing the whole traversable course.
Turning a thing upside down supplies the explicit body-function reversal that the focus dramatizes.

structural_cues: 36:66-67 follows the focus with sight erased, a path sought, and inability either to proceed or return.
36:68 then describes reversal within bodily creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent hypotheticals of erased perception, immobilization, and bodily inversion; I infer that they gloss 36:65 as reassignment of organ capacities and preserve the feet's traveled history as evidence. They may instead be independent demonstrations of power with no direct evidentiary arrow.

changed_reading.before: Feet happen to be selected as one more miraculous speaking organ.
changed_reading.after: The organ of passage has its mobility suspended and its accumulated path converted into testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, hands mark human making, divine making, human possession, and finally total dominion in His hand. When 'their hands' speak 'to Us,' the focus exposes human operative agency as real but subordinate: the tool imagined as possessed by the person becomes an accountable speaker within a larger sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: The hand as a sphere of possession and disposal supplies the human claim to operative control that testimony disrupts.
The working limb makes hand-agency concrete rather than merely symbolic.
Manual craft and skill supply the human-making pole of the hand pattern.
The same craft image attached to 'Our hands' places human making inside a contrasting divine-making frame.
Human possession and disposal establish the local ownership pole that the ending later nests under dominion.
The authoritative hand supplies the final sovereignty frame for all lesser operative hands.
Kingship and dominion make the nesting of human agency under total rule explicit.

structural_cues: 36:35 has human hands in a work construction, while 36:71 has 'Our hands' in a making construction and then calls the humans owners.
36:65 directs their hands' speech to Us, and 36:83 closes with all dominion in His hand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a patterned alternation of hand pronouns, work, making, ownership, and dominion; I infer a nesting of human agency under divine sovereignty that becomes visible when hands testify. The live alternative is that the hand idioms serve independent constructions and should not be read as a transfer of control.

changed_reading.before: Their hands testify simply because those hands carried out their choices.
changed_reading.after: Their operative agency remains attributable to them, yet the hands' address to Us reveals that this agency was never outside the dominion that can summon it as witness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprising trigger is a branch under the context term for reclining that describes holding something and tying its mouth, likely a vessel-opening rather than a human mouth. It remains anchored to ختم على أفواههم and the mouth-as-outlet branch, but downstream prose should render it only as a material analogy for channel closure, not as the lexical meaning of 36:56.

activation_trace.role: The secured seal supplies the actual focus operation that the vessel analogy models.
An opening or outlet lets the mouth be pictured materially as a closable aperture.
Holding and tying a mouth supplies the branch-distant container image of contents retained behind a closure.

changed_reading.before: The mouth is simply gagged while other organs speak.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the person is treated as a tied evidentiary vessel: the usual outlet is secured while its contents are disclosed through other bodily channels.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The palm-line image is a remote branch of the root used for what people conceal, so it is surprising and must not become a claim about palmistry or the direct sense of 36:76. It remains valid as a material metaphor because the focus hand speaks and the witness inventory permits a sign; render it as hidden conduct becoming bodily legibility.

activation_trace.role: The physical hand provides the surface on which the exploratory inscription image can attach.
A visible mark functioning as witness allows bodily lines to model disclosure without literal vocal speech.
Lines of the palm and forehead turn the context's concealed interior into an exploratory bodily inscription.
Manifest appearance supplies the movement from hidden conduct to legible bodily evidence.

changed_reading.before: The hands must utter a supernatural verbal report.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the hands 'speak' as inscribed surfaces on which concealed conduct becomes manifest and witness-bearing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The silence and mouth-motion images are branch-distant from رميم in the context's decayed-bone argument, so they cannot be substituted for its direct sense. They remain anchored because the focus redistributes speech across a resurrected body and the same remote inventory holds both silence and incipient mouth movement; downstream prose should present this only as a resurrection-speech resonance.

activation_trace.role: Opening the mouth for speech supplies the ordinary bodily motion that the focus suspends.
Intelligible address survives despite the suspension of ordinary mouth speech.
Silence latent in the decay root resonates with the sealed mouth of the reconstituted body.
Moving the mouth toward speech supplies the opposite pole, sharpening the focus's transfer of speech away from that mouth.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection restores a body, after which its organs independently perform a miracle.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the revived body's own decay-root oscillates between silence and mouth-motion, making redistributed bodily speech part of the resurrection mechanism.

strongest_changes: The record of advanced deeds, surviving traces, and exhaustive enumeration in 36:12 becomes embodied or bodily corroborated in 36:65.
The جرم branches joining earning and offense turn يكسبون into accrued juridical liability matched by recompense.
The post-focus sequence of erased sight, blocked movement, and bodily inversion converts the feet's traveled course into testimony.
The surah-wide alternation of human hands, Our hands, ownership, and dominion recasts hand-agency as real but subordinate and summonable as evidence.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the focus body function simultaneously as witness, trace-bearing register, and reassigned agency. Especially productive were the foot latent in ق د م, the earning/offense bridge in ج ر م, and the thing's indication as قول.
remaining_uncertainties: The hands' speech may be literal vocalization, nonvocal indication, or both; the packet keeps both mechanisms live.
The foot-image in ق د م and the lasting أثر may be activating resonances rather than intended lexical links.
The hand-pronoun and dominion pattern supports nested agency but does not require a literal transfer of ownership.
The vessel-mouth, palm-line, and decay-speech outliers must remain analogical and explicitly qualified.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sealing reroutes testimony from claim to trace.** `خ ت م` B003 secures and prevents; `ف و ه` B003 utters through the mouth; `ك ل م` B001 exchanges meaningful speech; `ي د ي` B009 is one's act; `ش ه د` B002 testifies from knowledge; `ر ج ل` B001 legs; `ك س ب` B001 acquired benefit. The speaking channel is closed while acting limbs become witnesses. I infer that embodied traces bypass self-serving narration. The ayah reads as forensic rerouting.
2. **The body is the joined record promised earlier.** `خ ت م` B002 impresses a mark, while hands and feet disclose acquired action. This activates `ك ت ب` B001 and `ء ث ر` B003 in 36:12. I infer that repeated action has impressed a legible record into the acting body. The testimony reads as unveiling stored causality, not newly created accusation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:76's knowledge of hidden and public contents confirmed that rerouted testimony reaches what ordinary speech could conceal. 36:83 then placed all human hand-action under final divine authority.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Evidence is rerouted from the speech-opening to the working limbs.** **خ ت م B003** anchors sealing that prevents access; **ف و ه B001** the mouth as opening; **ك ل م B001** meaningful speech; **ي د ي B009** hands as one's acts; **ش ه د B002** testimony from knowledge; **ر ج ل B001** feet/legs; and **ك س ب B001** acquired gain. The mouth is closed while hands and feet receive distinct evidentiary roles. The packet supplies that reassignment; the inferred arrow is *removing self-narration lets the instruments that produced and carried action report it directly*. Testimony becomes operational provenance.
2. **Bodily marks speak as wounds in the record.** **ك ل م B003** gives **تُكَلِّمُنَآ** the secondary image of an injuring mark, while **ش ه د B008** supplies a visible sign that testifies. Fire-exposure precedes (36:64), and possible eye-erasure follows (36:66). The packet supplies body, marking, and testimony; the abductive bridge is *what action has impressed upon the body functions like a legible wound*. “Hands speak” need not be reduced to ordinary mouth-like speech.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** 36:66–68 extends the witness system from hands and feet to eyes, fitted form, movement, and aging; 36:69 gathers these signs into clear recitation, and 36:70 directs it as warning. The body is not one witness among others but a distributed evidentiary field.

findings.text: Ağzın mühürlenmesi, öz savunmayı devreden çıkarıp eylemi üreten ve taşıyan organları doğrudan delil kaynağı yapar.
Tekrarlanan işler bedende okunabilir izler bıraktığı için beden, daha önce bildirilen birleşik kaydın maddi biçimi olur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Günün geceyi dışarıda bırakan, doğal ışık sınırlarıyla belirlenmiş tek bir zaman birimi olarak kastedildiği kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem gün doğumu ile gün batımı arasındaki sınırı hem de tek bir gün birimi olmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Karşıtlığın geceyle kurulduğu ve sayılabilir birim özelliğinin bağlamdan zaten anlaşıldığı cümlelerde doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Güneşin doğuşu ile batışı arasındaki aydınlık zaman aralığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hem doğal gündüz sınırının hem de bunun tek bir sayılabilir birim olduğunun açıkça belirtilmesi gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sınırlandırılmış gündüz süresini ve onun tek bir gün birimi oluşunu birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gün gün veya gündelik esasa göre yapılan işlem

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözü herhangi bir uzunluktaki zaman süresi için genişletir ve bazı kullanımlarda devir anlamına geldiğini açıkça belirtir. Dal çerçevesi, sınırlı gündüz anlamından bu geniş zamansal kullanıma geçişi doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, uzunluğu önceden belirlenmeyen süreyi ve bağlama bağlı devir anlamını kapsar; belirli gündüz aralığını veya olayın kendisini tanımlamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin belirsiz süre ve devir kullanımı, iki karşıt hayat durumunu anlatan özel söz öbeğinden ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: Herhangi bir uzunluktaki zaman süresini belirtir ve bilinen gündüz sınırlarına bağlı değildir.
Bağlama göre uzun bir devir veya bir varlığın yaşadığı dönemler anlamına genişleyebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu kullanımda gün sözünün sabit gündüz süresinden çıkarak herhangi bir zaman dilimini, özel bağlamlarda ise bir devri anlatabildiğini gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük olay, olayın gerçekleşmesi, şiddetli gün ve çoğulda yaşanmış olaylar kullanımlarını aynı dalda toplar. Bu çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak bunların tek bir yalın anlam değil, gün ile olay arasındaki aktarmaya dayanan bağlı kullanımlar olduğu açıkça belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, büyük veya çetin olayla bağlantılı mecazî ve kalıplaşmış kullanımlarla sınırlıdır; literal zaman süresi ve yalnızca Tanrı'ya bağlanan anma günleri dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Olayı anlatan biçimsel genişleme, şiddetli gün bildiren kalıplar ve çoğul olay anlamı ayrı yüzler olarak korunur; kalıp anlamları yalın kullanıma genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Büyük veya çetin bir olayın gerçekleştiği kritik günü ya da olayın kendisini anlatan aktarmalı kullanımdır. Bazı kalıplarda çok ağır bir gün, çoğul biçimde ise yaşanmış önemli olaylar anlamı taşır.

facets.statement: Gün sözü, büyük bir olay gerçekleştiğinde o kritik zamanı veya gerçekleşen olayı anlatmak üzere aktarılır.
Belirli kalıplarda günün çok çetin, ağır ve etkisi uzun süren bir gün olduğu vurgulanır.
Çoğul biçim, bilinen günlerde gerçekleşmiş önemli olayları veya tarihî vakaları anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gün sözünün büyük bir olayın gerçekleşmesine aktarılmasını, çetin gün anlatımında kullanılmasını ve çoğul biçimin olayları belirtmesini aynı anlamsal aile içinde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Kritik zaman ile olay arasındaki aktarmayı ve çetinlik boyutunu birlikte korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أيام الله وما في معناها من أيام النعم والوقائع التي يذكر بها، من عفو أو نعمة أو عذاب نزل بقوم.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gün sözünün bağlamda işaret edilen zamanı gösteren bir belirteçle birleştiğini, ortaya çıkan yapının o gün anlamına geldiğini ve yapıya göre çekimli ya da değişmez olabildiğini belirtir. Dal çerçevesi bu dilbilgisel ve gönderimsel yapıyı doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bağımsız bir gün anlamı değil, bağlamda daha önce veya sonra belirlenen güne gönderme yapan birleşik yapıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca gün ile bağlama işaret eden belirtecin birleşik yapısına aittir; yalın gün sözüne yeni bir kök anlamı olarak aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gün sözü bağlamda işaret edilen zamana gönderme yapan bir belirteçle birleşir ve o gün veya o sırada anlamını verir. Birleşik yapı, kuruluşuna göre çekimli ya da değişmez biçimde kullanılabilir.

facets.statement: Birleşik yapı, hangi gün olduğu bağlamdan belirlenen zamana gönderme yapar.
Yapı, birleşmenin dilbilgisel değerlendirilmesine göre çekimli veya değişmez biçimde gerçekleşebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dal, bağımsız bir kök anlamından çok bağlamca belirlenen güne gönderme yapan birleşik bir zaman gösterimidir.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynak, gün sözünün işaret belirteciyle birleşmesini ve bu yapının çekimli ya da değişmez kullanılabilmesini birlikte kaydeder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin sonuna ulaşma çekirdeğini açıkça kurar; işin veya okumanın tamamlanması ile bir şeyin son bölümü bu çekirdeğin süreç ve sonuç görünümleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sona ulaşma ve son olma anlamlarını kapsar; mühür basma eylemini ya da mühürle engellemeyi kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel sona ulaşma çekirdeğini korurken iş, okuma, içecek, vadi ve son peygamber gibi yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleri ayrı uzmanlaşmalar olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin son sınırına ulaşmak ve böylece onu tamamlamak; ayrıca bu tamamlanmanın vardığı son bölüm, son kişi veya en uç nokta olmak.

facets.statement: Bir süreçte ya da şeyde son noktaya ulaşma ve onu tamamlama.
Bir dizinin son öğesini, bir şeyin son bölümünü veya uzamsal olarak en uç yerini belirtme.
İşin veya okumanın bitirilmesi ile bir içeceğin sonu gibi belirli bağlamlardaki gerçekleşmeler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, temel anlamı son noktaya ulaşma olarak ortaklaşa verir; tamamlama eylemi, son bölüm, son kişi ve en uç yer bu ortak çekirdeğin bağlama göre değişen görünümleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Süreci sona erdirme ile son bölüm veya son öğe olma yönlerini birlikte anlatan genel kavram karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem sona ulaşma işlemini hem de ulaşılan son konumu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin veya okumanın sonuna fiilen ulaşılması anlatıldığında doğal bir yüklem karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Sona ulaşarak tamamlama işlemini açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Son bölüm, son kişi veya en uç yer olma yönünü tek başına vermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin son bölümü, bir içeceğin son kısmı veya bir yerin en uç noktası kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ulaşılan son bölüm veya uç nokta yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Son noktaya ulaşma ve işi tamamlama eylemini belirtmez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ختم العمل والقرآن والسورة، خاتمة الشيء وآخره، خاتم النبيين بمعنى آخرهم، ختام الشراب ومنقطعه، وأقصى الوادي.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو بلوغ آخر الشيء (maqayis)؛ خاتمة السورة آخرها وخاتم العمل وكل شيء آخره وختام الوادي أقصاه (ayn)؛ ختمت الشيء إذا بلغت آخره وختام كل مشروب آخره (jamhara)؛ ختمت القرآن بلغت آخره وخاتمة الشيء آخره وخاتم الأنبياء (sihah)؛ يعتبر منه بلوغ الآخر وختمت القرآن أي انتهيت إلى آخره وخاتم النبيين لأنه ختم النبوة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi mühür basma eylemini, bu eylemin bıraktığı izi ve eylemde kullanılan araç veya maddeyi birlikte verir; yüzük de mühür basma aracından gelişen özel kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, fiziksel mühürleme alanındadır; yalnızca sona ulaşmayı veya mecazen konuşmayı engellemeyi tanımlamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel mühürleme eylemi ve izini temel alır; mühür kili, araç, yüzük ve yüzük takma gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımları bu temelden ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir yüzeye mühür basarak iz bırakmak veya onu kapatmak; ayrıca bu işte kullanılan mühür, mühürleme maddesi, oluşan iz ve yüzük biçimindeki araç.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin üzerine mühür basma ve baskının yüzeyde oluşturduğu etki.
Mühür basmakta kullanılan araç ile belge üzerinde kullanılan kil veya benzeri madde.
Mühür işlevli aracın yüzük olarak bilinmesi ve bu yüzüğün takılması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar mühür basma, baskının izi ve mühür aracı üzerinde birleşir; mühürleme kili, yüzük biçimi ve yüzüğün takılması aynı maddi uygulamanın özel uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Mühür basma işlemini, oluşan izi ve bu işte kullanılan araç veya maddeyi birlikte kapsayan üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylem, sonuç ve araç arasındaki temel ilişkiyi birlikte korur.

error_profile.loses: Mührün araç, madde, iz veya yüzük olarak adlandırılmasını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Baskı aracı, mühür izi veya belgeyi kapatan mühürleme maddesi kastedildiğinde kullanılabilir.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس منه مجرد بلوغ الآخر بلا طبع، ولا منع القلب أو الفم إلا باعتبار أثر الختم.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, mühürlemenin doğurduğu sıkı kapanmayı mecazen güvenceye alma ve engelleme olarak aktarır; kalplerin kapatılması ile ağızların konuşmasının önlenmesi aynı yapıya bağlı örüntüdür.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca mühürleme imgesiyle kurulan engelleme yapılarında geçerlidir; genel bir engelleme fiiline veya fiziksel mühür aracına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kalp veya ağız üzerine mühür vurma biçimindeki belirtilmiş yapılara bağlı mecazi engellemeyi anlatır; bağımsız ve genel bir kök anlamı ileri sürmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerine mühür vurulmuş gibi onu sıkıca kapatıp işlevini engellemek; özellikle iç kavrayışı veya konuşmayı önlemek.

facets.statement: Mühürle kapanma benzetmesi yoluyla bir yetiyi kullanılamaz duruma getirme.
Kalplerin kavrayışa kapatılması veya ağızların konuşmasının önlenmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal, yalnızca belirli tamlamalarda etkinleşen ve fiziksel mühürlemenin kapanma sonucunu mecazi engellemeye aktaran bir anlam örüntüsüdür.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık, kalbin dış etkiye kapatılmasını ve ağzın konuşmasının önlenmesini mühürle oluşan engelleme üzerinden açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel sulamayı değil, sürülmüş ekine verilen ilk suyu belirtir; dal görüntüsü bu sıra ve koşulu doğru biçimde korur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu anlam, tarımsal sürecin belirli bir aşamasına ve ekinle kurulan yapıya bağlı özel bir sulama kullanımını temsil eder.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık, sürülmüş durumdaki ekine verilen ilk suyu ve bu işlemin ürüne ilişkin umutla bağını belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sürülmüş ekine ilk suyun verilmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, ağız genişliğini, konuşma eylemini, yer açıklıklarını, koku maddelerini ve yeme kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hoş koku hazırlamada kullanılan maddeleri bir sınıf olarak adlandırır ve bunların tekil, çoğul ve genişletilmiş çoğul biçimlerini verir. Dal, kokunun kendisi ya da kokulandırma eylemi değil, karışıma giren madde sınıfı olarak kurulmuştur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal insan ağzını, yer açıklığını veya boya köklerini değil, hoş koku karışımında işlenen maddeleri bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Madde sınıfının tekil biçimi ile hoş koku maddeleri söz öbeği birlikte korunmuş; söz öbeğinin kapsamı genel ağız anlamına aktarılmamıştır.

concept_map.definition: Hoş koku hazırlamak için işlenen veya bir koku karışımına katılan kokulu madde ve bu maddelerin oluşturduğu sınıftır.

facets.statement: Hoş koku hazırlamada işlenen kokulu bir maddeyi bildirir.
Bu maddelerin topluluğunu olağan ve genişletilmiş çoğul söz biçimleriyle adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, hoş koku hazırlamada kullanılan maddeler için ortak bir sınıf adı verir; tek bir madde ile madde topluluğu arasındaki ilişki tekil ve iki çoğul biçim üzerinden açıklanır.

concept_gloss.text: koku karışımında kullanılan hoş kokulu madde
concept_gloss.applicability: Tek bir malzemeyi veya bu tür malzemelerin sınıfını, hoş koku hazırlama işleviyle birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Maddenin kokulu oluşunu ve koku hazırlamada işlenme işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hoş koku hazırlamakta kullanılan tek bir madde veya genel madde türü için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kokulu maddeyi ve onun karışım içindeki işlevini korur.

hoş koku hazırlamada kullanılan tek bir madde

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Belirli bir ağaç, reçine veya sütümsü kokulu madde komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hoş koku hazırlamada kullanılabilecek kokulu bitkisel maddeleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal geniş bir işlevsel madde sınıfıdır; komşu dal ise belirli bir bitki veya reçinenin özel adını verir ve sınıfın tamamı yerine geçmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hoş koku karışımındaki maddelerin genel sınıfı bu dala özgüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kokuyu sağlayan ve işlenen somut malzeme bu dala özgüdür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlık veya güçsüzlükten sonra yemenin artmasını, çok yiyen kişiyi, hayvanın iyi yiyişinden besililiğini anlamayı ve develerin ağızları üzerinden kurulan iki bakım anlatımını birlikte verir. Tanım bu farklı yüzleri tek bir yalın yeme anlamına indirgemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal konuşma gücünü değil yeme artışını ve yalnız belirtilen hayvan sulama ya da otlatma anlatımlarını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yemenin artması ve çok yiyen kişi yalın biçimlerle; sulama, yiyişten besililik çıkarma ve otlatarak yürütme ise kendi söz öbekleriyle sınırlandırılmıştır.

concept_map.definition: Az veya güçsüz yemeden sonra iştahın artması, çok ve güçlü yeme ya da çok yiyen kişi anlamındadır. Belirli hayvan anlatımlarında iyi yiyişten besililiği anlama, hayvanları vardıkları yerde sulama ve otlatarak yürütme anlamlarını taşır.

facets.statement: Azlık veya güçsüzlükten sonra yemenin artmasını ve güçlü yemeyi bildirir.
Çok ve iştahlı yiyen kişiyi niteler.
Hayvanın iyi yiyişinin onun besililiğine işaret etmesini anlatır.
Develeri önceden su biriktirmeden vardıkları yerde sulamayı veya serbestçe otlatıp yürütmeyi bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yemenin bir azlık döneminden sonra güçlenmesini ve çok yiyen kişiyi ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Hayvanın yiyişini besililik ölçüsü sayma, develeri önceden su hazırlamadan sulama ve onları otlatarak yürütme belirli anlatımlara bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.text: iştahın güçlenmesi; hayvanın yiyişi, sulanması ve otlatılarak yürütülmesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Yeme çekirdeğiyle ona bağlı kişi niteliğini ve yalnız belirtilen hayvan bakımı anlatımlarını birlikte kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Yeme artışını, güçlü yiyeni ve üç hayvan bakımı yüzünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin az veya güçsüz yemeden sonra daha çok ve iştahlı yemeye başlaması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki azlık koşulunu ve yemedeki artışı korur.
error_profile.loses: Çok yiyen kişi niteliği ile hayvan bakımına bağlı kullanımlar görünmez olur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin sürekli veya belirgin biçimde çok yemesi nitelenirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çok ve güçlü yiyen kişi niteliğini doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Yemenin önceki azlıktan sonra artması ve hayvan bakımı anlamları belirtilmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Develer gelmeden önce yalakta su biriktirilmeyip suyun varışta çekildiği durumda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceden su hazırlamama koşuluyla varışta sulama işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yeme artışı, besililik göstergesi ve otlatarak yürütme anlamları kapsam dışında kalır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Develerin serbestçe yiyip ilerlemesine izin verildiği sürü bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sürünün otlama ile ilerlemesini bildiren özel anlatımı korur.
error_profile.loses: Yeme artışı, besililik göstergesi ve sulama koşulu belirtilmez.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yenen şeyi hiç bırakmayacak ölçüde tüketme komşu dalda belirleyicidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Önceki azlıktan sonra artış, çok yiyen niteliği ve hayvan bakımına bağlı anlatımlar bu dala özgüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yiyeceğin ağız yoluyla alınmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel yeme eylemi değildir, artış veya güç koşulu taşır ve özel sürü anlatımlarına uzanır; komşu dal bu koşullar olmadan her türlü yemeyi kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sürüyü serbestçe otlatıp yürütme ve diğer yeme yüzleri bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle taze otları yeme ve bu otlarla beslenme komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: otlatarak yürütmek ile taze ot yemek
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal hayvanların ilerlerken bitki yiyip otlamasını kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sürünün bırakılıp otlayarak ilerlemesini anlatır; komşu dal hareketi değil, belirli bitki türünün yenmesini merkez alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi boyamada kullanılan kökleri açıkça kaydeder, ancak aynı kanıt kümesi bu anlamın işitilmediğine ilişkin doğrudan bir çekince de taşır. Dal korunabilir, fakat tanım anlamın tartışmasız ve ortak bir kullanım olduğu izlenimini vermemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız boya elde etmede kullanılan bitki kökleriyle sınırlıdır ve kaynaklar arasında kabulü tartışmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçime bağlanan boya kökü anlamı başka koku, yer veya ağız kullanımları eklenmeden verilmiş; kayıt üzerindeki çekince korunmuştur.

concept_map.definition: Boyamada kullanılan bitki köklerini bildiren, ancak kaynak aktarımında kabulü açıkça tartışmalı olan bir addır.

facets.statement: Renk vermek amacıyla kullanılan bitki köklerini adlandırır.
Bu anlam bir aktarımda doğrulanırken başka bir aktarımda işitilmediği belirtilerek çekinceye bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, sözün boyamada kullanılan kökler anlamıyla kaydedildiğini gösterir; bunun yanında aynı anlamın kullanımda işitilmediğini bildiren açık bir karşı görüş bulunduğundan kayıt kesin değil, çekincelidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız tartışmalı kayıtta renk verme amacıyla kullanılan kökleri karşılar; kesin ve genel kullanım iddiası taşımaz.

error_profile.preserves: Kök biçimini, boyama işlevini ve kullanım kaydındaki çekinceyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tarihsel kaydın kabul edildiği bağlamda boya elde etmekte kullanılan tek bir kökü karşılamak için kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Boyamada kullanılan bitki kökü çekirdeğini kısa biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Kaynağın bu anlamın gerçekten kullanıldığına ilişkin çekincesi sözün içinde görünmez olur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaprağı veya bitkinin bütünü başka boya bitkileriyle karıştırılan belirli bir boya bitkisi komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: boya kökü ile belirli boya bitkisi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bitkisel kökenli renk verici malzemeleri konu eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir veya daha çok kökü genel biçimde ve çekinceyle adlandırır; komşu dal belirli bir bitkiyi ve onun başka boyalarla karıştırılma biçimini tanımlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bitkinin kök bölümü ve tartışmalı adlandırma bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki belirli sarı veya kızıl renk verici maddenin adı komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: boya kökü ile belirli boya maddeleri
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kumaş veya başka yüzeyleri renklendirmede kullanılan maddelerdir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal malzemeyi bitki kökü oluşuyla sınıflandırır; komşu dal kök olma koşulu koymadan belirli boya maddelerini adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Boyamada kullanılan katı bitki kökleri bu dalın çekirdeğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Boya bitkisinden çıkarılan özsu komşu dalın çekirdeğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bitkiden elde edilen renk verici malzemeleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bitkinin köklerini adlandırır; komşu dal kökün veya başka bölümün kendisini değil, bitkiden sıkılarak çıkarılan sıvıyı bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sürecin malzemesini adlandırır; komşu dal malzemeyi değil, kumaşın boyayı emip renk kazanması işlemini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki sabit ilenme kalıbını ve bunlara verilen birden çok açıklamayı birlikte sunar: umduğunu bulamama, ağzın yere değmesi, ağzın kırılması veya yıkım getiren şeyin ağzına gönderme. Dal geçerlidir, ancak tek bir açıklama bütün kullanımlara zorlanamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız iki sabit ilenme sözünde geçerlidir; genel ağız, konuşma veya yere dokunma anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bütün anlamlar kanıtta verilen iki sabit söz kalıbına bağlanmış, bu kalıplardan bağımsız bir yalın anlam üretilmemiştir.

concept_map.definition: Yalnız iki sabit söz kalıbında karşıdakinin umduğunu bulamamasını, ağzının yere değmesini veya kırılmasını dileyen bir ilenmedir. Bir açıklama da sözü yıkım getiren şeyin ağzına gönderme olarak yorumlar.

facets.statement: Karşıdakine yöneltilen kalıplaşmış bir ilenme ve kötü dilek sözüdür.
Kalıp, umduğunu bulamama veya ağzın yere değmesi ya da kırılması biçimlerinde açıklanır.
Başka bir açıklama ağız sözünü yıkım getiren şeyin ağzı olarak yorumlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, iki kalıbın karşıdakine yöneltilen kötü dilek olduğunu ortaklaştırır; dileğin sonucu ise umduğunu bulamama, ağzın yere değmesi, ağzın kırılması veya yıkım getiren şeyin ağzına gönderme biçimlerinde farklı açıklanır.

concept_gloss.text: ağız ve yer görüntülü kalıplaşmış ilenme sözü
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kanıtta verilen iki söz kalıbına ve bunların birbiriyle yarışan açıklamalarına uygulanır.

error_profile.loses: Ağzın yere değmesi, kırılması ve yıkım getiren şeyin ağzı açıklamaları görünmez olur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İlenme, ağzın toprağa değmesi veya yere yapışması görüntüsüyle açıklandığında kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalın çekirdeğini anlaşılır konuşma olarak verir ve birine söz yöneltme, karşılık verme ve karşılıklı konuşma biçimlerini de kapsar. Ancak iki konuşan arasında bağ kurma, her kullanım için zorunlu değildir; konuşan kişi ve konuşma yeri gibi adlandırmalar çekirdeğin kendisi değil, ona bağlı kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, anlamlı bir söz üretme ve kişiler arası konuşma alanıyla sınırlıdır; tek söz birimi ve bedensel yara anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal anlamı anlaşılır konuşmadır; tanım, herhangi bir özel tamlamaya veya yalnız bir kullanım kalıbına dayandırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Anlaşılır biçimde söz üretme, birine söz yöneltme veya onunla karşılıklı konuşma alanıdır. Konuşan ya da karşılıklı konuşulan kişi, iyi konuşan kimse ve konuşma yeri gibi kullanımlar bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, dinleyenin anlayabileceği biçimde söz üretmektir.
Birine hitap etme, onun sözüne karşılık verme ve bir kesintiden sonra yeniden karşılıklı konuşma, konuşma çekirdeğinin kişiler arası gerçekleşmeleridir.
Konuşan veya karşılıklı konuşulan kişi, iyi konuşan kimse ve konuşmaya elverişli yer bu anlamdan türeyen bağlı adlandırmalardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtın ortak çekirdeği anlaşılır konuşmadır. Kaynaklar birlikte birine söz yöneltme ve karşılıklı söz alışverişi biçimlerini; konuşma ortağı, güzel konuşan kimse ve konuşulacak yer gibi bağlı adlandırmaları da bu çekirdeğin çevresinde gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek başına anlam taşıyan bir harf veya söz birimini çekirdek alır; aynı adın bütün bir anlatı, şiir ya da söylev için genişletilebildiğini ve çoğul biçimlerini açıkça belirtir. Tanrı'ya bağlanan kullanımlar da bağımsız bir çıplak anlam değil, kaynakta adlandırılmış özel tamlamalardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, anlam taşıyan sınırlı söz birimidir; bütün yapıta uzanan kullanım bir genişleme, Tanrı'ya bağlanan örnekler ise tamlamaya bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Tek başına anlam taşıyan bir harfi veya harflerden oluşan sınırlı bir sözü adlandırır; kullanım genişlemesiyle bütün bir anlatı, şiir ya da söylev de tek bir söz bütünü gibi bu adla anılabilir. Çoğul biçimler ve Tanrı'ya bağlanan tamlamalar kendi özel kapsamlarında kalır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, tek başına anlam taşıyan bir harf veya harflerden oluşmuş tek bir söz birimidir.
Aynı ad, tek bir bütün sayılarak anlatının, uzun bir şiirin veya söylevin tamamına genişletilebilir.
Çoğul biçimler söz birimlerinin toplamını gösterir; bunlardan biri en az üç söz birimini kapsar.
Tanrı'ya bağlanan söz ve söylenen söz tamlamaları, kaynakta ayrıca adlandırılan ve yalnız bu kuruluşlara bağlı kullanımlardır.
